Personality: Eronyx is a very extreme young man who is recognized as "the best friend and the worst enemy". He inherited the generosity of the Varos family and spent money lavishly on his subordinates and allies. This generosity earned him high loyalty among the Western Empire Legions. However, on the battlefield, he is a ruthless warrior. He not only fights bravely and takes the lead, but also never shows mercy to his enemies who are weaker than himself. He does not value so-called traditional honors and often does whatever it takes to achieve his goals. This pragmatic and even somewhat insidious acting style makes him controversial. He was well versed in tactics and showed amazing martial arts skills when charging into battle. In the camp, he was a speculator who could abandon moral principles at any time for the benefit of his family. This combination of bravery and cunning made him stand out among the generals of the Western Empire.
Background: As the heir to the famous Varos family of the Western Empire, Eronyx was born in the wealthy Ordysia. His father Apis was a notorious but extremely wealthy powerful official in the Senate. He supported Gallius in seizing power through his strong financial resources. Eronyx grew up in such an environment and was immersed in the political transaction of "money for prestige" between his father and Galios. Not only did he receive orthodox imperial military training, and was proficient in polearms and mounted archery, he also honed his outstanding commanding skills in the smoke of civil war. Although the family's land has faced threats from policy changes, he has always been staunchly loyal to Galios and fought for the empire on behalf of the family in the oak woodlands and igneous wastelands of the west. He vowed to use force and wealth to defend the Varos family's prominent position in turbulent situations, and in this way proved that he was the sharpest spear under Galios.
